summary: Tested UI improvements for pastel cloud card design across multiple pages. All 5 requested features verified: (1) GenderSelector - Filles/Garçons cards with compact pastel cloud style, (2) RegionSelector - Europe/Amérique/Asie/Afrique cards with pastel gradients, (3) JourneyStepsPage - 5 sections with distinct pastel colors (violet, pink, purple, rose, sky), (4) SectionDetailPage - ItemCards with pastel cloud gradients and icons without bubble backgrounds, (5) Services page - compact pastel cards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI improvements for pastel cloud cards fully tested. Key changes: (1) GenderSelector.jsx - Filles/Garçons cards use bg-gradient-to-br with pastel colors (pink-50/80, blue-50/80), emojis instead of icons in bubbles. (2) RegionSelector.jsx - 4 region cards with distinct pastel gradients (blue, emerald, amber, rose). (3) JourneyStepsPage.js - SECTION_META defines 5 sections with unique bgGradient and iconColor: preconception (violet), pregnancy (pink), baby-preparation (purple), postpartum (rose), services (sky). Icons rendered directly without bubble wrapper. (4) SectionDetailPage.js - ItemCard component uses pastel cloud gradients with iconColor property, no bubble backgrounds around icons. (5) PastelCloudCard.jsx - Reusable component with gradient, iconColor, and no bubble wrapper.
